## Callouts & Bubbles

Speech and thought bubbles for annotating or quoting — these are designed to hold text.

::: {.shape-speech-bubble fill="#3498db" .shape-md}
Hello!
:::
::: {.shape-callout-round fill="#2ecc71" .shape-md}
Hi!
:::
::: {.shape-callout-rounded fill="#e74c3c" .shape-md}
Hey!
:::
::: {.shape-callout-oval fill="#9b59b6" .shape-md}
Yo!
:::
::: {.shape-callout-thought fill="#3498db" .shape-md}
Hmm...
:::
::: {.shape-callout-cloud fill="#ffffff" stroke="#3498db" .shape-stroke-md .shape-md}
Poof
:::
::: {.shape-callout-explosion fill="#f1c40f" .shape-md}
Boom!
:::

## Fill & Stroke

These are not separate shapes — they show the `fill=` and `stroke=` attributes (any CSS color) plus the `.shape-stroke-*` width classes applied to any shape above.

::: {.shape-circle fill="none" stroke="#3498db" .shape-stroke-lg .shape-md}
:::
::: {.shape-star fill="#e74c3c" stroke="#111111" .shape-stroke-md .shape-md}
:::
::: {.shape-cube fill="#3498db" stroke="#111111" .shape-stroke-md .shape-md}
:::

## Rotation

Also a modifier, not a shape group — the `.shape-rotate-*` classes turn any shape in 45° steps.

::: {.shape-triangle fill="#9b59b6" .shape-rotate-180 .shape-md}
:::
::: {.shape-arrow fill="#3498db" .shape-rotate-90 .shape-md}
:::
::: {.shape-moon fill="#f1c40f" .shape-rotate-270 .shape-md}
:::
